scope: Analytic all-pole synthetic signals, labels are current code anchor regions; not human or Mandarin vowel ground truth
noise_pitch_policy: White noise uses only first f0 entry to avoid duplicate signals
metrics: forced closure frequency in sustained interior
separate F1 and F2 median absolute error
sudden_closure: mouth_open below0.25 times median of same sustained interior; count only median>=0.3
protocol: Run development baseline first; choose candidate on development, commit before one paired validation. Preserve all failures. Fixed full grid; no wall-clock cutoff. Any later reuse is regression, not unseen validation. Do not tune anchor labels to outputs.

generation.filter: Periodic steady-state irfft(rfft(excitation)/denominator), remove DC, normalize RMS; no clipping
generation.white_noise: numpy default_rng(seed) Gaussian, identical seed reused across anchors/rates for paired mechanism comparison

supersedes: v1 fixture omitted last sub-cutoff harmonic when cutoff/f0 was not integral; v1 retained, not comparable gate evidence
